title: Response Cache
analytics_desc: Analytics for LiteLLM's response cache (e.g. Redis / in-memory): requests answered from cache without calling the LLM provider. Provider-side prompt caching (cached input tokens from Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) is not shown here; see "Prompt Caching Metrics" on the Usage page or individual requests in the Logs page.

coordination.title: Coordination Redis
coordination.desc: Redis used to coordinate work across proxy pods: cross-pod rate limits, spend tracking, and the pod lock manager. It is configured independently of the response cache.
